question: Which of the following bridges is constructed over the Brahmaputra River in India? (RRB JE ECE (22/04/2025) Shift 2 CBT 2)
options: Dhola-Sadiya Bridge
Howrah Bridge
Mahatma Gandhi Setu
Pamban Bridge
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Dhola-Sadiya Bridge

Explanation:
The Dhola-Sadiya Bridge, also known as Bhupen Hazarika Setu, is built over the Lohit River, a tributary of the Brahmaputra, connecting Assam and Arunachal Pradesh. It is the longest bridge in India and was inaugurated in 2017. The Howrah Bridge is over the Hooghly River, Mahatma Gandhi Setu is over the Ganges River, and Pamban Bridge is over the sea.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Longest bridge over Brahmaputra → Bhupen Hazarika Setu (Dhola-Sadiya)
☛ Longest bridge in India → Dr. Bhupen Hazarika Setu (Assam)
☛ Longest bridge over Ganges → Mahatma Gandhi Setu (Bihar)
☛ Howrah Bridge is over which river → Hooghly River (West Bengal)
☛ Where is Pamban Bridge located → Rameswaram (Tamil Nadu)
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा पुल भारत में ब्रह्मपुत्र नदी पर बनाया गया है? (RRB JE ECE (22/04/2025) Shift 2 CBT 2)

question: What is the general orientation of the Himalayan ranges in the northwestern part of India? (RRB JE ECE (22/04/2025) Shift 2 CBT 2)
options: East-South
Northeast to Southwest
South-North
Northwest to Southeast
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Northwest to Southeast

Explanation:
The Himalayan ranges in the northwestern part of India generally have a Northwest to Southeast orientation. This orientation is a result of the tectonic collision between the Indian Plate and the Eurasian Plate, along with regional geological structures. In the western Himalayas, between the Indus and Sutlej rivers, this trend is clearly visible as the mountain chains extend in this direction. Major ranges such as Zanskar, Ladakh, and Pir Panjal also follow this orientation. This alignment influences the region's climate, river systems, and geomorphic development.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the general orientation of the Himalayas? → Northwest to Southeast
☛ What caused the formation of the Himalayas? → Collision of Indian and Eurasian plates
☛ Which is the major river in the western Himalayas? → Indus
☛ What is the highest peak of the Himalayas? → Mount Everest
☛ Which range forms the southern boundary of the Himalayas? → Shivalik Hills
question_hi: भारत के उत्तर-पश्चिमी भाग में हिमालय पर्वतमाला का सामान्य झुकाव क्या है? (RRB JE ECE (22/04/2025) Shift 2 CBT 2)

दक्षिण-उत्तर

solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है उत्तर-पश्चिम से दक्षिण-पूर्व

Explanation:
हिमालय पर्वतमाला भारत के उत्तर-पश्चिमी भाग में उत्तर-पश्चिम से दक्षिण-पूर्व दिशा में झुकी हुई है। यह झुकाव मुख्य रूप से भारतीय और यूरेशियन प्लेटों के टकराव के कारण उत्पन्न तनाव और क्षेत्रीय भूगर्भीय संरचना का परिणाम है। पश्चिमी हिमालय में सिंधु और सतलुज नदियों के बीच यह प्रवृत्ति स्पष्ट दिखती है, जहां पर्वत श्रृंखलाएं इसी दिशा में विस्तारित हैं। हिमालय की प्रमुख श्रेणियाँ जैसे जास्कर, लद्दाख, और पीर पंजाल भी इसी दिशा में अभिविन्यस्त हैं। यह झुकाव क्षेत्र के जलवायु, नदी प्रणाली और भू-आकृतिक विकास को प्रभावित करता है।

question: Who is known as the leader of the Green Revolution in India? (RRB JE ECE (22/04/2025) Shift 2 CBT 2)
options: C Subramaniam
Prof. MS Swaminathan
Dr. Rajendra Prasad
Tribhuvandas Kishibhai Patel
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Prof. MS Swaminathan

Explanation:
Prof. MS Swaminathan is known as the father of the Green Revolution in India. In the 1960s, he played a key role in developing high-yielding varieties of wheat and rice. His efforts helped India become self-sufficient in food grains and overcome famine conditions. He collaborated with the International Rice Research Institute and the International Maize and Wheat Improvement Center. Swaminathan was awarded the World Food Prize. The Green Revolution promoted the use of fertilizers, irrigation, and pesticides to boost agricultural productivity.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ In which decade did the Green Revolution start? → 1960s
☛ Wheat variety used in Green Revolution? → Lerma Rojo 64
☛ Key components of Green Revolution? → High-yielding varieties, fertilizers, irrigation, pesticides
☛ Which award did Prof. Swaminathan receive? → World Food Prize 1987
☛ Impact of Green Revolution on India? → Increased food production and self-sufficiency
question_hi: भारत में हरित क्रांति के नेता के रूप में किसे जाना जाता है? (RRB JE ECE (22/04/2025) Shift 2 CBT 2)

डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद
त्रिभुवनदास किषीभाई पटेल
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है प्रो. एम.एस. स्वामीनाथन

Explanation:
भारत में हरित क्रांति के जनक प्रो. एम.एस. स्वामीनाथन को माना जाता है। उन्होंने 1960 के दशक में उच्च उपज देने वाली गेहूं और चावल की किस्मों को विकसित करने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई। उनके प्रयासों से भारत खाद्यान्न में आत्मनिर्भर बना और अकाल की स्थिति से उबरा। इन्होंने अंतर्राष्ट्रीय चावल अनुसंधान संस्थान और अंतर्राष्ट्रीय गेहूं और मक्का सुधार केंद्र के साथ सहयोग किया। स्वामीनाथन को विश्व खाद्य पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया। हरित क्रांति में उर्वरक, सिंचाई और कीटनाशकों के उपयोग को बढ़ावा दिया गया।

question: Which of the following is NOT a source of release of smokestacks? (RRB JE CE (22/04/2025) Shift 2 CBT 2)
options: Rivers
Thermal power plants
Smelters
Industries
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Rivers

Explanation:
Smokestack emissions refer to gases and particles released into the atmosphere during industrial processes or energy generation. Thermal power plants burn coal to produce electricity and have tall chimneys that emit smoke. Smelters release harmful gases during metal extraction. Industries use smokestacks in their manufacturing processes. In contrast, rivers are water bodies and not sources of air pollution. They are associated with water pollution, but not with smokestack emissions.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Main cause of smokestack emissions → Coal-based thermal power plants
☛ Harmful gas released from smelters → Sulfur dioxide (SO₂)
☛ Type of pollution caused by rivers → Water pollution
☛ Alternative name for smokestack → Chimney
☛ Use of smokestacks in industries → To release waste gases into the atmosphere
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा धूम चिमनी के उत्सर्जन का स्रोत नहीं है? (RRB JE CE (22/04/2025) Shift 2 CBT 2)

तापीय विद्युत संयंत्र
गलनागार
उद्योग
solution_hi:

Explanation:
धूम चिमनी (स्मोकस्टैक) से उत्सर्जन का तात्पर्य औद्योगिक प्रक्रियाओं या ऊर्जा उत्पादन के दौरान वायुमंडल में छोड़ी गई गैसों और कणों से है। तापीय विद्युत संयंत्र कोयला जलाकर बिजली उत्पन्न करते हैं और इनमें ऊंची चिमनियाँ होती हैं जो धुआँ उत्सर्जित करती हैं। गलनागार (स्मेल्टर) धातु निष्कर्षण के दौरान हानिकारक गैसें छोड़ते हैं। उद्योग अपनी विनिर्माण प्रक्रियाओं में चिमनियों का उपयोग करते हैं। इसके विपरीत, नदियाँ जल निकाय हैं, वायु प्रदूषण का स्रोत नहीं। वे जल प्रदूषण से संबंधित हैं, लेकिन धूम चिमनी उत्सर्जन का स्रोत नहीं हैं।

question: Which of the following is NOT toxic to non-target organisms in the soil? (RRB JE CE (22/04/2025) Shift 2 CBT 2)
options: Herbicides
Fungicides
Organic fertilisers
Pesticides
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Organic fertilisers

Explanation:
Organic fertilisers are made from naturally occurring microorganisms that enhance soil fertility and are not toxic to non-target organisms. They provide nutrients to plants without harming the soil ecosystem. In contrast, herbicides, fungicides, and pesticides are chemical compounds that can harm both target and non-target organisms. These chemicals can kill beneficial soil organisms such as earthworms, bacteria, and fungi, reducing soil biodiversity and fertility. Organic fertilisers are environmentally friendly and maintain soil health. They do not contain synthetic chemicals and are safe for non-target soil biota. Their use supports sustainable agriculture by promoting a healthy and balanced soil ecosystem.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Main component of organic fertiliser → Microorganisms (e.g., Rhizobium, Azotobacter)
☛ Effect of chemical fertilisers → Reduce soil biodiversity
☛ Impact of pesticides → Harm non-target organisms
☛ Benefit of organic farming → Protects soil health
☛ Harmful to soil biodiversity → Chemical pesticides
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन मिट्टी में गैर-लक्षित जीवों के लिए विषाक्त नहीं है? (RRB JE CE (22/04/2025) Shift 2 CBT 2)

कवकनाशी

कीटनाशक

Explanation:
जैविक उर्वरक प्राकृतिक रूप से पाए जाने वाले सूक्ष्मजीवों से बने होते हैं जो मिट्टी की उर्वरता बढ़ाते हैं और गैर-लक्षित जीवों के लिए विषाक्त नहीं होते। वे मिट्टी के पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना पौधों को पोषक तत्व प्रदान करते हैं। इसके विपरीत, घासनाशी (हर्बिसाइड्स), कवकनाशी (फंगिसाइड्स), और कीटनाशक (पेस्टिसाइड्स) रासायनिक यौगिक हैं जो लक्षित और गैर-लक्षित दोनों जीवों को नुकसान पहुँचा सकते हैं। ये रसायन मिट्टी के लाभकारी जीवों जैसे केंचुआ, बैक्टीरिया और फफूंद को मार सकते हैं, जिससे मिट्टी की जैव विविधता और उर्वरता कम हो जाती है। जैविक उर्वरक पर्यावरण के अनुकूल होते हैं और मिट्टी के स्वास्थ्य को बनाए रखते हैं।

question: The practice of Jhum cultivation is prevalent in the __________. (RRB JE CE (22/04/2025) Shift 2 CBT 2)
options: South east
North west
South west
North east
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is North east

Explanation:
Jhum cultivation, also known as shifting agriculture, is predominantly practiced in the north-eastern states of India. This traditional farming method involves clearing forest land by burning, cultivating it for a few years, and then abandoning it to allow forest regrowth. The north-eastern region, including states like Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Mizoram, and Meghalaya, heavily relies on this practice. Despite modern agricultural specialists considering it unsustainable for long-term productivity, it remains deeply integrated into the cultural and community life of the region. Jhum cultivation is often associated with tribal communities and reflects their indigenous knowledge of land management.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is Jhum cultivation also known as? → Shifting agriculture
☛ In which part of India is Jhum cultivation prevalent? → North-eastern states
☛ Which agricultural practice is common in North-east India? → Jhum cultivation
☛ What method is used in Jhum cultivation? → Clearing forest by burning
☛ Which states are associated with Jhum cultivation? → Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Mizoram, Meghalaya

उत्तर पश्चिम

उत्तर पूर्व
solution_hi:

Explanation:
झूम खेती, जिसे स्थानांतरण कृषि भी कहा जाता है, मुख्यतः भारत के उत्तर-पूर्वी राज्यों में प्रचलित है। यह एक पारंपरिक कृषि पद्धति है जिसमें वन क्षेत्रों को जलाकर साफ किया जाता है और कुछ वर्षों तक खेती की जाती है। इसके बाद भूमि को पुनः वन के हवाले कर दिया जाता है। उत्तर-पूर्वी क्षेत्र में यह विधि मुख्यतः अरुणाचल प्रदेश, नागालैंड, मिजोरम, मेघालय आदि राज्यों में अपनाई जाती है। हालांकि आधुनिक कृषि विशेषज्ञ इसे अस्थायी उपज के लिए अनुपयुक्त मानते हैं, फिर भी यह क्षेत्र की सांस्कृतिक और सामुदायिक जीवनशैली का अभिन्न अंग है।

question: In which of the following regions the Himalayas has the greatest width? (RRB JE CE (22/04/2025) Shift 2 CBT 2)
options: Arunachal Pradesh
Kashmir
Himachal Pradesh
Sikkim
solution:

question: What type of farming is practised in hill regions by cutting slopes into steps? (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (09/06/2025) Shift 1)
options: Extensive farming
Mixed farming
Wetland farming
Terrace farming
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Terrace farming

Explanation:
In hilly regions, cutting slopes into steps for cultivation is known as terrace farming. This method is commonly practiced in mountainous areas of Asia, such as the Himalayas, Philippines, and South America. The main purpose is to prevent soil erosion and conserve rainwater by reducing the speed of water flow. Terraces provide flat surfaces on slopes, which help retain water and make the land more fertile. Crops like rice, wheat, corn, and millets are typically grown using this method. Terrace farming has been used by ancient communities for centuries and is a sustainable agriculture technique that prevents landslides and supports food production in steep terrains. It is especially important in areas with heavy rainfall where soil loss would otherwise be severe.

question: The irrigation method in India that distributes water through pipes under low pressure to each plant is called: (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (09/06/2025) Shift 2)
options: furrow irrigation
localised irrigation
tubewell irrigation
canal irrigation
solution:

Explanation:
Localised irrigation, also known as drip irrigation or trickle irrigation, is an efficient method that delivers water directly to the root zone of each plant through a network of pipes under low pressure. This technique helps in water conservation and reduces weed growth. Water is applied slowly as drops that infiltrate the soil, minimising evaporation and runoff. It is particularly beneficial in arid regions and for crops like fruits, vegetables, and orchards. question: The Great Plateau of India is a part of which ancient landmass? (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (09/06/2025) Shift 2)

Laurasia
Gondwana Land
solution:

question: Which Himalayan range is the northern-most and contains the loftiest peaks? (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (09/06/2025) Shift 3)

question: Where is plantation agriculture mainly practised in India? (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (09/06/2025) Shift 3)

Rajasthan and Gujarat
Punjab and Haryana
Kerala and Assam
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Kerala and Assam

Explanation:
Plantation agriculture in India is mainly practiced in tropical regions with high rainfall and humid climate. Kerala and Assam are the primary states for this type of farming. Kerala is known for plantations of coconut, rubber, coffee, and tea, while Assam is world-famous for its tea plantations. Plantation agriculture involves large-scale cultivation of a single crop using scientific methods and machinery. It is a commercial form of agriculture requiring intensive labor. In Kerala, both Arabica and Robusta coffee varieties are grown, and Assam has vast tea estates. In contrast, Rajasthan and Gujarat are arid regions with limited plantation, Punjab and Haryana focus on grain cultivation, and Odisha-Chhattisgarh have forest and tribal agriculture.

question: Which transport system is most efficient in terms of energy consumption per tonne-km in India? (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (10/06/2025) Shift 1)

Inland waterways
Railways
solution:

Explanation:
In terms of energy consumption per tonne-km, inland waterways are the most efficient transport system in India. This is because water offers low friction, requiring less energy to move cargo compared to road or rail, where higher friction and weight increase energy use. India has an extensive inland waterway network of 14,500 km, primarily used for transporting bulk goods like coal, iron ore, and construction materials. question: The role of the Himalayas in shaping India's climate includes all, EXCEPT which of the following? (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (10/06/2025) Shift 1)

This tree is well-adapted to arid and semi-arid conditions, with deep roots that allow it to survive with minimal water. Khejri plays a vital role in the desert ecosystem: its leaves serve as fodder for livestock, its pods are used as food, and it provides shade and fuel for local communities. It is also the state tree of Rajasthan. The other options are not suited to the Thar Desert: Teak grows in moist tropical forests, Neem requires more moisture, and Sal is found in tropical deciduous forests. Thus, Khejri is the correct answer.

question_hi: थार  के मैदानों  में आमतौर पर कौन सा पेड़ पाया जाता है? (RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I (10/06/2025) Shift 2)

solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है खेजड़ी

Explanation:
थार रेगिस्तान के मैदानों में सबसे अधिक पाया जाने वाला पेड़ खेजड़ी (Prosopis cineraria) है। यह शुष्क और अर्ध-शुष्क क्षेत्रों में उगता है और रेगिस्तानी पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है। खेजड़ी गहरी जड़ों वाला वृक्ष है जो कम पानी में जीवित रह सकता है। इसकी पत्तियाँ पशुओं के चारे के काम आती हैं और फलियाँ मानव उपभोग के लिए उपयोगी होती हैं। राजस्थान का राज्य वृक्ष होने के साथ-साथ यह गाँवों में छाया और ईंधन भी प्रदान करता है। अन्य विकल्पों में सागौन नम क्षेत्रों में पाया जाता है, नीम अधिक नमी वाले स्थानों पर, और साल उष्णकटिबंधीय वनों में पाया जाता है, इसलिए थार के मैदानों में ये उपयुक्त नहीं हैं।
